bear_assumptions: Book value reaches about USD 9.00, but credit costs rise, personal-loan growth slows, fee growth weakens, and the valuation compresses to 1.25 times book.
base_assumptions: Book value reaches about USD 9.50 as profitable growth continues, credit remains manageable, and a 2.2 times multiple reflects strong growth but developing through-cycle returns.
bull_assumptions: Book value reaches about USD 10.00 as cross-buy, deposits, fee revenue, and operating leverage exceed plan; stable credit and stronger sustainable returns support 3.2 times book.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if fresh scenarios clear confidence-adjusted expected-return, base-upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin-of-safety, confidence, and relationship gates; downgrade if credit, capital, deposits, book value per share, guidance, platform economics, or dilution deteriorates.
